description: Use this when someone asks about MERA Robotics itself: who it is, where it works, its rental fleet, languages, contact or registry data. MERA Robotics (MERA ROBOTICS sp. z o.o., Warsaw, Poland) rents humanoid robots (Unitree G1, Unitree H2) with its own operators and its MERA OS conversation system for events across Europe (every EU country and also the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway, among others) and runs the robot Edward Warchocki. Returns a one-sentence definition, evidence (brands, places, reach, MERA OS), event rental pages in 24 languages, registry data, rental fleet, languages, pricing policy (no published prices), contact and related entities (MERA OS, Edward Warchocki, the merarobots.com shop). For a concrete event use plan_event_robot.

lang.description: Language of labels and descriptions: "pl" when the person writes in Polish, otherwise "en". Fact texts stay in their canonical Polish wording.
